purpose: Define each local or remote DWH source participating in federation as an explicit origin identity with exact endpoint/address, instance, schema and governance boundary.

topics.name: DWH Federated Source Identity
topics.purpose: Define each local or remote DWH source participating in federation as an explicit origin identity with exact endpoint/address, instance, schema and governance boundary.

semantics.identity_rule: Each federated source has an explicit logical source/origin identity.
semantics.origin_rule: Origin identity remains distinct from transport endpoint, EXT registration and local federation alias.
semantics.instance_rule: Source resolves exact remote/local instance identity.
semantics.governance_rule: Each source retains its own authorization, assurance, classification and output-governance boundary.
semantics.ownership_rule: Federation never transfers semantic ownership to the querying node.
semantics.availability_rule: reachable, authorized, schema-compatible and query-participating are distinct states.
semantics.alias_rule: Federation aliases are bindings only and never replace origin identity.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.

hard_gates.condition: remote endpoint used as semantic source identity
federation query node becomes owner of remote data

references.purpose: Remote sources use governed DWH addressing.
EXT metadata never replaces semantic source identity.
